Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Reduced Porter's per-winner greeting cooldown from 30 minutes to 5 minutes. Added 50 built-in first-name Studium prize greetings in a shuffled rotation that uses all 50 before reshuffling. The new Rotate 50 Porter greetings option is enabled automatically; turn it off to use the existing editable custom greeting.
